## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install my_first_library in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure my_first_library package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to my_first_library
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/akarim23131/my_first_library):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/akarim23131/my_first_library.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/akarim23131/my_first_library)

``` sh
$ conda install -c akarim23131 my_first_library
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/my_first_library/)

``` sh
$ pip install my_first_library
```

### Documentation
